offering_description.value: Centuri builds, upgrades, and maintains natural gas and electric networks for utilities. Its field crews install and replace gas mains and service lines, build overhead and underground power lines, and restore power after storms. It also provides construction services for renewable energy and industrial projects.

primary_services.value: Gas pipeline installation and replacement; electric transmission and distribution construction; utility network maintenance and repair; storm restoration; renewable energy and industrial construction

customer_segment.value: B2B: Investor-owned gas and electric utilities, electric cooperatives, renewable energy developers, and industrial facility owners; B2G: Municipal utilities

end_markets.value: Natural gas utilities; electric utilities; renewable power generation; industrial facilities

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Utility construction, maintenance, and storm restoration under master service agreements or individual project contracts

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses field crews, equipment, and materials to build and maintain infrastructure for utilities and project owners

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Gas pipeline work, electric line construction, storm restoration, and renewable energy and industrial construction

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Utility procurement teams and project owners through bids and negotiated agreements

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Pipeline safety and worker qualification rules, excavation and electrical safety standards, and environmental permitting requirements

notes: The current relative scale of the gas and electric contracting lines is uncertain.
